words.gloss: he of eloquent speech, and every

literal: Knowing virtue, possessing mature and dignified speech, at all times, he who knows the best way is the companion of deliberation.
translation: He who knows virtue, speaks with mature and refined words, and knows the best way to accomplish tasks, is the ultimate companion for counsel at all times.
modern: அறத்தை அறிந்து, நிறைந்த பண்புகளுடன் கூடிய சொற்களைப் பேசும் ஆற்றல் உடையவனாய், எக்காலத்திலும் செயல்படும் திறனை அறிந்தவனே ஆராய்ந்து முடிவெடுப்பதற்குச் சிறந்த துணையாவான்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential qualities of an ideal advisor or minister. First, they must have a deep understanding of righteousness (அறனறிந்து) to ensure all decisions are ethical. Second, they must possess mature, refined, and persuasive speech (ஆன்றமைந்த சொல்லான்) to communicate counsel effectively. Third, they must have practical knowledge of the best methods to execute tasks (திறனறிந்தான்). A person with these traits is the perfect companion for deliberation (தேர்ச்சித் துணை) at all times.
